description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Senior division at the 2005 World Championships, pairing Dark Tyranitar's attacks with Pidgeot's card searching. The 2005 World Championships were held at the Town and Country Resort and Convention Center in San Diego, California, from 19 to 21 August 2005.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2005 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
